caption:
White days fasting: three days each month, fasting for a lifetime.

The Prophet ﷺ said that fasting three days of each month is fasting for a lifetime, and he named the shining days of Al-Bid: the thirteenth, fourteenth and fifteenth. By the calculated Hijri calendar, this month's white days run from Saturday to Monday.

Sunan an-Nasa'i 2420 · Grade: Hasan

Missed today? Sunday and Monday are still ahead, so set your intention tonight.

#whitedays #ayyamulbid #sunnahfasting #hadith
alt_text: It was narrated from Jarir bin 'Abdullah that the Prophet said:"Fasting three days of each month is fasting for a lifetime, and the shining days of Al-Bid, the thirteenth, fourteenth and fifteenth (Sunan an-Nasa'i 2420)
